distance.wire: rounded integer mm; compare unrounded metres

selection: confirmed edges sorted by actual distance, OSM qualified key, OCM qualified key; each site consumed once
confirmation: within 50 m and at least one shared reviewed socket family; UNKNOWN/unreviewed labels cannot confirm
probable: greater than 50 and at most 150 m plus shared normalized operator/network/name; review only, no merge
conflict: within 50 m without a shared reviewed socket family; no merge
fields: OSM point/name/address; OSM operator/network then OCM; source fallback with explicit field lineage; select one usable address object
quantities: preserve every source assertion/group/equipment; never total or maximize across sources

hierarchy.parent: unique explicit source membership or unambiguous footprint containment

identity: sha256 of domain abastevo:ev-site:v1 plus NUL and primary qualified source key; source alias preservation belongs to publication
status: static source metadata, never live availability
coverage: catalog/source units, not a complete Brazil physical inventory
